title: Relay hosting through the master server (no port forwarding)
body: master-server gains a stdlib WebSocket /relay with 6-char rooms (max 16 clients). scripts/relay_peer.gd is a MultiplayerPeerExtension over WebSocketPeer; Net.host_game_relay / join_relay, R- codes, RELAY rows in Browse. Gate C relay case runs host + client through the relay binary.

title: Menu translations: es, pt_BR, de, fr
body: assets/i18n/ui.csv (155 keys) imported as Godot translations; Settings.language + apply_language(), picker in Settings. Host panel verified by screenshots in fr and de.

title: Translate in-match HUD strings
body: Kill feed, status lines, scoreboard headers and toasts are still English; many are built with format strings and need tr() with placeholders.

title: Deploy a public master server so relay and listing work out of the box
body: Relay and internet listing need a master server on a public host (Docker image or the dist binaries, see server/master-server/README.md). Ship its URL as the default once it's running.
